title: Never Negative! Modulus Explained Simply | PUC Maths Class 11
description:
Ride 3 km east and Aarav is 3 km from home. Ride 3 km west and he is still 3 km from home, not minus 3. Direction can be negative; distance never is. In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 2, Relations and Functions) we meet the modulus function and the rational function.

You will watch the V-shaped graph of |x| draw itself as Aarav rides along a straight road, slide the corner of |x - k| live, and watch 1/x shoot up as x comes closer to zero, never touching the axes. Two pause-and-think questions, a worked example solving |x - 2| = 5 as distances on the number line, the exam trap about the square root of x squared, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and JEE Main students.

In this video:
0:00 3 km east or 3 km west: still 3 km away
0:29 The modulus function: two-part rule
1:09 Live: the V graph and sliding |x - k|
1:42 Identity vs modulus: side by side
2:20 Rational functions and 1/x
3:18 Worked example: |x - 2| = 5
4:01 Exam trap: the square root of x squared
4:20 Where it is asked
4:31 Practice question (JEE Main pattern)
5:12 Recap and three questions to answer

Next episode (Ep 21): Signum and Greatest Integer Functions. Age is counted in completed years: 16.9 years old is still 16.
